messages:
Maya (AE): BankNova procurement is blocking the POC until we hand over SOC2 artifacts, an ISO network diagram that shows peering options, a signed pen-test attestation, and an encryption/KMS statement. They want creds only after those items. Can we move fast?
Ethan (SE): I can prep the ISO diagram and a short tech checklist. Do they accept a redacted SOC2 exec summary while NDA is in flight?
Ravi (Security Eng): We release the full SOC2 Type II package only under NDA. We can give an executive summary + control mapping immediately. We do not provide raw access logs. For pen-test attestation we have a template legal signs.
Priya (Legal): I can sign the attestation but need the exact language around findings and report access. Please paste the draft attestation here.
billing-bot: Quick provisioning note: Hosted POC creds: 48-72h. Dedicated w/ VPC peering & CMK: 5-8 business days. Preliminary cost delta estimate: Dedicated ~+22-30% for short reserved capacity.
Ethan (SE): BankNova SRE asked if customer-managed keys/HSM can be demoed in the POC.
Ravi (Security Eng): CMK/HSM demos require Dedicated. We can provide an attestation that "customer key separation is enforced on Dedicated deployments". Hosted uses our managed keys and standard encryption controls.
Maya (AE): Contact at BankNova is security@banknova.com. I'll request CIDR and confirm if they will execute an NDA quickly. Trying to keep creds turnaround under 72h if they accept Hosted constraints.
Ravi (Security Eng): Pen-test attestation draft (please review):
```
Redwood Inference 8 Pen-Test Attestation
- Recipient: <BankNova>
- Scope: staging environment, API endpoints, authentication flows, and specified integrations
- Assessment: Independent third-party security assessment executed on <MM/YYYY>. Detailed findings are retained internally; an executive summary and redacted findings may be shared immediately. The full assessment report will be provided to the customer upon execution of an NDA and with appropriate handling controls.
- Remediation Status: High/critical items were remediated or have documented mitigations.
- Signatory: Authorized Legal signatory (name)
```
Priya (Legal): That wording is acceptable. Swap "retained internally" for "held by Redwood under controlled access" and I'll sign once <MM/YYYY> is added. Confirm we won't disclose raw logs.
Ravi (Security Eng): Confirmed 8 we do not share raw logs. Update: replace phrase as Priya requested.
Ethan (SE): Tech artifact checklist (draft): SOC2 Type II package (full report via NDA), SOC2 exec summary + control narratives, ISO network diagram with peering/allowlist callouts, signed pen-test attestation, short-lived staging API key + presigned SFTP for artifact upload.
billing-bot: Note: If BankNova requires a private tenancy or dedicated subnet with static egress IP, ops will produce a tailored quote. Ballpark add: +$X/day for short-term reserved capacity.
Maya (AE): Proposed sign-off flow: Security drafts -> Legal signs -> AE sends to customer. Priya, ok to proceed?
Priya (Legal): OK. Once Security finalizes attestation and provides the assessment month I will sign. Please also include a one-line EU-data-residency clause if BankNova asks (they're EU-based).
Ravi (Security Eng): We can add a short residency line if they specify region. For EU-based POCs we can commit to in-region processing for the POC and note backup policies in the residency attestation.
Ethan (SE): If they opt for Dedicated to get CMK, lead time 5-8 business days and I need their infra contact to coordinate allowlist windows.
Maya (AE): Action items: 1) Ravi: post final attestation with <MM/YYYY> and SOC2 exec summary. 2) Ethan: finish ISO diagram and estimate Dedicated lead time. 3) Priya: pre-approve signatory and sign once the date is added. 4) Maya: request NDA + CIDR from security@banknova.com and push for Hosted if they accept constraints.
Priya (Legal): I'll standby to sign as soon as the attestation is updated.
Maya (AE): Thanks team 8 I'll update BankNova and ask for NDA turnaround and target staging window (they requested next-week). If they insist on CMK, I'll surface the cost/time trade-off immediately. :rocket:
